clayHead.label: Layer View
clayHead.line: Mark the giant's weak point for 6 s.

watcherHead.label: Scan Intent
watcherHead.line: Mark the giant's weak point for 12 s and read its next blow.

clayCore.label: Barrier
clayCore.line: For 6 s every blow on the frame lands at half.

kilnCore.label: Barrier
kilnCore.line: For 8 s every blow on the frame lands at a third.

lightCore.label: Hasten
lightCore.line: For 6 s the frame's walk and arms run at 1.5x.

clayArms.label: Sunder
clayArms.line: A clay blade 30 m long drawn from the arm: everything on its line cut.

strongArms.label: Telekinesis
strongArms.line: Draw the nearest loose thing within 60 m into your hand.

quickArms.label: Gust
quickArms.line: A cone of wind 45 m ahead: staggers the giant, breaks glass and timber.

clayLegs.label: Shape
clayLegs.line: Heave the ground round your feet: 12 m carved, the giant knocked off balance.

springLegs.label: Portal
springLegs.line: Step through a portal 40 m ahead.

crabLegs.label: Lift Ground
crabLegs.line: Lift the ground in a 16 m ring and drop it: the giant staggered.

treadLegs.label: Carve
treadLegs.line: Cut the ground open round the treads, 10 m: a heavy blow on the giant's legs.
